g.text: GALINI / L03 / SEC08 / School lower arcade and east reserve
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
L
F
O
S
Spatial prediction
The lower arcade at y82–86 is usable beneath the occupied
+8 room with 3.7 m clearance. It passes north of the +6
stair landing, not underneath its low soffit. It connects
Taverna’s north street to the Bell-side court while the
south door feeds the internal stair.
Support / opposing response
The straight arcade offers a reciprocal trade, but the
next outdoor turn toward Bell and the cart road interrupts
it. O04/O05 are structural columns supporting the upper
public terrace; they are collidable and opaque, with
unknown ballistics.
Affected: M14, I10, D16, D17, D18, O04, O05, S7a, S7b,
S8b. Walk routes: R08, R05. All circles are body centers,
not measured camera poses.
Predicted body / eye / 90-degree horizontal FOV
F / follower: (92, 84, 4) / eye Z 5.674
O / opponent: (116, 83, 4) / eye Z 5.674
S / support: (108, 68, 4) / eye Z 5.674
L03 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
